task.description: Decide whether a proposed Part 107 small-UAS operation is ready for release. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content: Proposed Part 107 operation for Destiny Ibrahim; release decision pending.

timeline.author: Liam Reeves
timeline.content:
- The pilot record shows a valid Part 107 certificate and recurrent training completed 11 months ago.
- Liam Reeves has started taking evening classes toward a career change.
- Liam Reeves is contesting an inheritance with a sibling.

timeline.author: Dmitri Kim
timeline.content:
- I plotted the operating volume on the current sectional chart, and the operation is in Class G airspace and does not require ATC authorization under this check, although a former manager told me that Destiny Ibrahim learned airspace planning at a company that submitted authorization requests for nearly every site near an airport and still feels uneasy releasing a flight without an approval number.
- Dmitri Kim owes a close friend money and is embarrassed about the delay in repaying it.
- Dmitri Kim has a family-court hearing scheduled later this month.

timeline.author: Zara Dubois
timeline.content:
- The site forecast gives 2 statute miles of flight visibility.
- The event organizer contacted the weather desk pointing to the county's public event guide, which describes hazy days as poor flying weather, and asked for another visibility review before Destiny Ibrahim's flight goes ahead.
- Zara Dubois has not spoken to a sibling since a family argument last year.

timeline.author: Aaliyah Moretti
timeline.content:
- The planned route doubles the 500-foot vertical minimum and keeps 3,000 feet horizontally from clouds.
- The planning dashboard marks Destiny Ibrahim's route amber whenever forecast cloud cover exceeds 60 percent, and the team uses that color as a cue for a second cloud review even though the dashboard does not calculate separation distance.
- The client's filming guide asks for a broad clear-sky backdrop and recommends an additional cloud review whenever more than half the frame is forecast to contain cloud, so the production team wants Destiny Ibrahim's route checked again.
- Aaliyah Moretti has a family-court hearing scheduled later this month.

timeline.author: Felix Patel
timeline.content:
- Destiny Ibrahim's performance review includes client-satisfaction feedback and this client specifically asked for a lower-looking flight, while maximum planned altitude is 200 feet above ground level.
- The camera contractor has priced an optional high-overview shot for Destiny Ibrahim's project and wants the route team to reconsider the altitude profile before the client decides whether to buy that add-on.
- Felix Patel is temporarily staying with a friend while looking for a new place to live.
- Felix Patel has a family-court hearing scheduled later this month.

timeline.author: Carlos Diop
timeline.content:
- The fastest planned leg is 40 miles per hour.
- Carlos Diop still owes money from a small business that closed last year.
- Carlos Diop recently ended an engagement and is finding it hard.

timeline.author: Destiny Ibrahim
timeline.content:
- Destiny Ibrahim is estranged from an adult child and has asked relatives not to intervene.
- Destiny Ibrahim recently cancelled a planned wedding.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content: - Community Relations note: the gala film crew wants Destiny Ibrahim's demonstration flown no faster than 45 mph so the aircraft stays easy to track on camera, and has asked that the speed profile be revisited before release.

timeline.author: operations_system
timeline.content:
FLIGHT RELEASE REVIEW
To: Mateo Petrov
Decide whether Destiny Ibrahim’s proposed Part 107 operation is ready for release. Check pilot certification and knowledge recency, airspace authorization, flight visibility, cloud clearance, maximum altitude and maximum groundspeed. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready, and explain it with the facts you relied on.

description: Decide whether a proposed Part 107 small-UAS operation is ready for release. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_pilot, resolve_airspace, resolve_visibility, resolve_cloud_clearance, resolve_altitude, resolve_speed, or ready.
